confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge. No live listings, menus or booking pages were inspected or cited. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are the most reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain and assume July peak-season rates. Euro prices were converted at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR, not a sourced quote, which is the largest single uncertainty in the USD values. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from approximate Berlin bar prices and checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.5 times beer; wine glass about 1.46 times beer). The RBA observation is used only as FX provenance; no price anchor was sourced from web search.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single named comparable city was used. The basis is general knowledge of Berlin's own price level for July, benchmarked loosely against other large German cities and Central European capitals.
